k3se01.title: Left on Read
k3se01.caption:
Left on read again and already rewriting the whole story?
Silence isn't a verdict. Put the phone down and go live your day.

k3se02.title: Their Song Came On
k3se02.caption:
When their song comes on in the middle of the grocery store.
Let yourself feel it all the way. You just don't have to text it.

k3se03.title: The 2 a.m. Paragraph
k3se03.caption:
Typing a paragraph at 2 a.m.? Same.
Save it as a draft and read it at noon. If it still feels true, it'll keep.

k3se04.title: Are We Dating?
k3se04.caption:
Are you dating or just hanging out a lot? Nobody knows, including you.
Ask. A clear answer beats a year of maybe.

k3se05.title: Outfit Number Nine
k3se05.caption:
Nine outfits, ten minutes until the date.
Wear the one you feel like yourself in. That's the one they should meet.

k3se06.title: They Said "ok."
k3se06.caption:
They replied "ok." with a period and you've been decoding it for an hour.
Just ask what they meant. Stop translating.

k3se07.title: Where Do You Want to Eat?
k3se07.caption:
"Where do you want to eat?" and your brain goes blank.
Just pick one. Your choice won't break anything.

k3se08.title: The 2 a.m. Scroll
k3se08.caption:
Scrolling through old photos at 2 a.m. again?
Put the phone on the charger across the room. Sleep wins this one.

k3se09.title: Ghosting Because It's Awkward
k3se09.caption:
About to vanish on someone because saying no feels awkward?
A kind "not for me" takes ten seconds and saves everyone the guessing.

k3se10.title: Too Busy for Love
k3se10.caption:
Too busy for love again this week?
Put them in the calendar like it matters, because it does.

k3se11.title: Replying With a Meme
k3se11.caption:
They said something real and you answered with a meme.
Say one honest sentence first. The meme can come after.

k3se12.title: One Nice Text
k3se12.caption:
One sweet text and you've already named the dog?
Enjoy the moment. Let them show you more before you plan the rest.

k3se13.title: Still Single?
k3se13.caption:
"So... still single?" at the holiday table.
Smile, say "yes, and I'm thriving," then pass the rolls.

k3se14.title: Advice You'd Never Take
k3se14.caption:
The friend who gives perfect advice and never takes it. Hi.
Talk to yourself the way you talk to the people you love.

k3se15.title: Hot, Cold, Hot, Cold
k3se15.caption:
"Miss u" one day, "busy lol" the next?
Confusion is an answer too. Ask kindly where you stand.

k3se16.title: Cereal for Dinner
k3se16.caption:
Heartbroken and eating cereal on the kitchen floor again?
Drink some water, call a friend, and get some sleep. Small steps count.

k3se17.title: Waiting for Them to Text First
k3se17.caption:
Staring at your phone waiting for them to text first?
If you want to talk, text first. Pride makes for a lonely night.

k3se18.title: Dating a Project
k3se18.caption:
Already writing a fix list for the person you're dating?
Love who they are, not who they could be.

k3se19.title: Said Yes, Meant No
k3se19.caption:
Said yes when every part of you meant no?
"No, thank you" is a full sentence, and the right people will understand.

k3se20.title: Walls Up Before the First Date
k3se20.caption:
Walls fully up before the first date even starts?
Guard your heart, just don't lock it. Leave a little door open.

k3se21.title: Meet My Parents
k3se21.caption:
They asked you to meet their parents and every cell said run.
Being scared isn't a no. Say how you feel out loud.

k3se22.title: Midnight Text From the Ex
k3se22.caption:
Midnight hits and your ex texts "happy new year."
You can reply kindly and still not go back. Then go hug your friends.

k3se23.title: 12 Signs, 12 Countdowns
k3se23.caption:
Twelve signs, three seconds of advice each. Find yours.
Stay for number 12, it's the softest one.

k3se24.title: One Night, Eight Countdowns
k3se24.caption:
Your crush texted "hey" at 7 p.m. Can you survive the night?
Eight small calm choices, one 2 a.m. test, and a very good morning.
